about.heroText: INSULFILM™ is the first and most recognized film brand in Brazil for automotive and architectural glass. Over 35 years innovating in films for glass and metallic surfaces. Since 1986, INSULFILM™ has revolutionized how Brazilians experience their glazed environments, transforming this experience into comfort and protection with sophistication.
about.timelineClosing: INSULFILM™ doesn't protect glass, it protects you.

timeline.e1996: World's largest glass film distributor, title granted by the world's largest industry at the time, headquartered in the USA.
timeline.e1996b: First to offer architectural anti-vandalism and security protection films — INSULFILM™ SafetySecurityFilm.
timeline.e1997: First to offer films manufactured by OEM system with specific characteristics for the Brazilian climate.
timeline.e1998: We led the change in the sector by directly supporting Contran regulation for the commercialization of automotive films.

Our goal is to ensure maximum protection, well-being and sophistication for your travels, your home and your workplace.

faq4.q: How do I know if the film is original?

glossary.mechContent: Tensile Strength: maximum force the film withstands before breaking. Rupture Force: load required to break the film. Pull-out Force: adhesive resistance to detachment. Elongation at Break: stretching capacity before rupture. Puncture Force: resistance to point perforation.
glossary.solarContent: VLT (Visible Light Transmission): percentage of visible light passing through the film. UV Rejection: ability to block ultraviolet rays. Optical Clarity: transparency and visual clarity quality of the applied film.

privacy.heroSubtitle: Learn how INSULFILM™ collects, uses and protects your personal data, in compliance with Brazil's General Data Protection Law (LGPD — Law No. 13,709/2018).
privacy.introText:
INSULFILM™ respects your privacy and is committed to protecting your personal data. This Privacy Policy describes how we collect, use, store and share information when you access our website or use our services.

By using our website, you agree to the practices described in this policy.
privacy.dataText:
We may collect the following types of data:

• Identification data: name, email, phone number (when voluntarily provided through contact or quote forms).
• Browsing data: IP address, browser type, pages visited, time spent, traffic source and device used.
• Approximate location data: based on IP address, for statistical analysis purposes.
privacy.cookiesText:
We use cookies and tracking technologies to improve user experience and analyze website performance. The tools used include:

• Google Analytics 4 (GA4): collects anonymized browsing data for traffic and behavior analysis.
• Google Tag Manager (GTM): manages third-party scripts and tags on the site.
• Microsoft Clarity: records browsing sessions (heatmaps and recordings) for usability analysis, without capturing sensitive personal data.

You can manage or disable cookies in your browser settings.
privacy.purposeText:
Collected data is used for the following purposes:

• Responding to contact and quote requests.
• Improving browsing experience and website performance.
• Conducting statistical analysis of access and behavior.
• Sending relevant communications about products and services (only with your consent).
• Complying with legal and regulatory obligations.
privacy.sharingText:
Your personal data is not sold, rented or transferred to third parties for commercial purposes. We may share information with:

• Essential service providers (hosting, data analysis), under confidentiality agreements.
• Competent authorities, when required by law or court order.
• INSULFILM™ franchisees and authorized stores, exclusively to fulfill requests made by you.
privacy.rightsText:
Under Brazil's General Data Protection Law (Law No. 13,709/2018), you have the right to:

• Confirm the existence of data processing.
• Access your personal data.
• Correct incomplete, inaccurate or outdated data.
• Request anonymization, blocking or deletion of unnecessary data.
• Request data portability to another provider.
• Revoke consent at any time.
• Obtain information about sharing of your data.

To exercise your rights, please contact us through the channels listed below.
privacy.retentionText: Your personal data is stored for as long as necessary to fulfill the purposes for which it was collected, or as required by legal, contractual or regulatory obligations. Browsing data collected by analytics tools follows each platform's retention policies (Google, Microsoft).
privacy.securityText: We adopt appropriate technical and organizational measures to protect your personal data against unauthorized access, loss, alteration or destruction. This includes use of secure connection (HTTPS), restricted access control and periodic review of our security practices.
privacy.contactText:
For questions, requests or to exercise your rights related to privacy and data protection, please contact us:

• Email: privacidade@insulfilm.com.br
• Phone: +55 (11) 3611-2474
• Address: Rua Catão, 72 — Lapa, São Paulo — SP, Brazil, ZIP 05049-000
privacy.updatesText: This Privacy Policy may be updated periodically to reflect changes in our practices or legal requirements. We recommend that you review this page regularly. Any significant changes will be communicated visibly on the website.

faqPage.heroSubtitle: Find quick answers to the most common questions
faqPage.auto1Q: Which film is recommended for my car?
faqPage.auto1A: The choice depends on your needs. For maximum thermal comfort, we recommend the LT Polariz or LT Matrix. For good performance with value, the LT VIP or LT Eclipse. For security, the Anti-Vandalism 13K or SkudoGuard. For paint protection, the Phantom® PPF.
faqPage.solar1Q: Does the film darken the glass too much?
faqPage.solar1A: Each line has different visible light transmission (VLT) levels. We offer options from light tints to maximum darkening allowed by CONTRAN legislation.
faqPage.solar2Q: Can the film be applied to the windshield?
faqPage.solar2A: Yes, we have the PB (Windshield) line with four options: PB Matrix, PB Skye, PB Design and PB PhantomGlass — all within limits allowed by legislation.
faqPage.solar3Q: How long does the film last?
faqPage.solar3A: Durability varies by line. The LT Polariz and LT Matrix lines have lifetime warranty. The Phantom® PPF has a 10-year warranty. All original films are designed to last years without discoloring.
faqPage.sec1Q: What is an "anti-vandalism film" or "security film"?
faqPage.sec1A: It is a protection film designed to increase the natural resistance of glass, being very important before and after breakage, making a given environment safer for people. The distinction between "anti-vandalism film" and "security film" is usually linked to the performance — higher or lower — of resistance between films.
faqPage.sec2Q: How to choose between the existing protection and security film options?
faqPage.sec2A: Seek to understand and determine the level of protection you desire. If unsure, seek guidance from an INSULFILM™ Authorized consultant. We will be happy to help clarify situations of accidental or intentional breakage, as well as present which films can effectively serve you.
faqPage.sec3Q: Is the resistance performance the same if the window is partially open?
faqPage.sec3A: No. All testing and resistance demonstration videos are performed with windows closed. When closed, the glass with film is accommodated in the car's own structure, serving as fundamental anchoring in any accidental or intentional action against the glass.
faqPage.sec4Q: Will the film show expected resistance immediately after application?
faqPage.sec4A: No. The film will only show its full resistance performance after 30 days of application, the period necessary for complete drying.
faqPage.sec5Q: On which windows can these films be applied?
faqPage.sec5A: All movable side windows not glued to the door structure.
faqPage.sec6Q: What type and thickness is an automotive side window?
faqPage.sec6A: In Brazil, the vast majority of vehicles have tempered side windows with a thickness of 1/8" — 3.18mm.
faqPage.sec7Q: Does the application of protection and security films affect the manufacturer's warranty?
faqPage.sec7A: No. The vehicle will remain 100% original. Since it doesn't alter originality or collaterally affect its operation, the vehicle remains covered by the manufacturer's warranty.
faqPage.sec8A: It is the abbreviation for Protection and Security. Films in this category have a generic denomination, on an imperial scale, that qualifies only their thickness. That's why the terms "PS4", "PS8", "PS12" and similar became common. Thickness alone is not synonymous with resistance — evaluate the mechanical physical properties.
faqPage.sec9Q: Does thickness determine the film's resistance performance?
faqPage.sec9A: Not necessarily. Film performance is effectively determined by the manufacturing process technology and its industrial components, directly resulting in the mechanical physical properties of resistance.
faqPage.sec10Q: What are the main technical resistance indices I should research?
faqPage.sec10A: For automotive use on tempered glass: Puncture Force, Rupture Force and Elongation at Break. However, all other indices also contribute to a stronger and more resistant film.
faqPage.sec11Q: How to identify if performance technical data is reliable?
faqPage.sec11A: We recommend searching for recognized and reliable film brands, with a history of proper testing and positive responses against criminal or accidental approaches. Also, verify which test methods the films were subjected to.
faqPage.sec12Q: How to identify if testing videos on the internet are real or fake?
faqPage.sec12A: We reinforce the recommendation to look for recognized and reliable film brands. Also, doubt videos where at the moment of glass breakage by an aggressive/criminal act, there are no shards projected externally — it's almost certain that a film was applied externally.
faqPage.sec13Q: Does the product warranty period affect the film's resistance performance?
faqPage.sec13A: Yes. During the warranty coverage period, the film is expected to show technical stability, especially regarding the adhesion of its self-adhesive layer.
faqPage.sec14Q: What is the difference between vandalism and robbery crimes?
faqPage.sec14A: Vandalism is characterized by an act of property destruction, without theft. Robbery is qualified by the subtraction of a good through serious threat or violence against the person.
faqPage.sec15Q: Do protection and security films work against theft?
faqPage.sec15A: No. The film may eventually delay the action time, but it cannot be said to prevent it. Theft is characterized by a criminal act without violence against the victim.
faqPage.sec16Q: Do protection and security films offer ballistic resistance?
faqPage.sec16A: No. If your protection expectation is against firearms, we recommend ballistic armoring of the vehicle.
faqPage.sec17Q: Can protection and security films increase my protection in case of accidents?
faqPage.sec17A: Yes. By increasing the resistance of the original glass and retaining most of the broken glass fragments in the film itself, lamination reduces the severity of possible damage by reducing fragment projection.
faqPage.sec18Q: Can protection and security films affect rescue or hinder exit from the car in accidents?
faqPage.sec18A: They do not affect rescue. There is no registered history of negative interference for victim evacuation from the vehicle.
faqPage.sec19Q: How to know if the protection and security film was correctly applied?
faqPage.sec19A: The film will only have its maximum effectiveness if applied over almost the entire glass surface — beyond the exposed and visible area — excluding only the space for the glass fixture in its mechanism. It's necessary to remove it from the vehicle to receive the film.
faqPage.sec20Q: Why can't these films be applied to the windshield, fixed side windows, rear window and sunroof?
faqPage.sec20A: Because these glasses are glued to the car structure, it's not possible to apply over the entire surface, generating the rupture of the glass/film combination at the end of the film coverage area.
faqPage.sec21Q: Are protection and security films applied internally or externally?
faqPage.sec21A: For automotive use, internal fixing is mandatory.
faqPage.sec22Q: Is it necessary to disassemble the door panels? Is there a risk of damaging any component?
faqPage.sec22A: There are cases where disassembly is necessary and others where it's not, varying from vehicle to vehicle. The risk of damage is inherent to the service but uncommon and rare.
faqPage.sec23Q: Is it normal for the film to show spots during the drying period after application?
faqPage.sec23A: Yes. The average total drying time is 25 days, which can extend to 30 days depending on sun exposure. We recommend leaving the vehicle exposed to the sun to optimize drying.
faqPage.sec24Q: Are protection and security films transparent or tinted (darkened)?
faqPage.sec24A: Both options exist, without interference on resistance performance. INSULFILM™ offers this category in the transparent option, so you choose the solar film of your preference.
faqPage.sec25Q: Do cars without door pillar columns have the same resistance performance?
faqPage.sec25A: No. The anchoring of the glass with film on the door's side pillar is fundamental for resistance performance. This is more common in convertible and/or coupé cars.
faqPage.sec26Q: Is it possible to apply protection and security films on vehicles with bulletproof glass?
faqPage.sec26A: No. There is physical incompatibility with polycarbonate, and there is also no gain in resistance performance.
faqPage.sec27Q: I have a used armored vehicle and the windows are delaminating. Can I use protection films as a substitute for polycarbonate?
faqPage.sec27A: Not recommended and ballistic warranty will be compromised. INSULFILM™ Authorized dealers are not allowed to offer this service as a substitute for polycarbonate.
faqPage.arq1Q: Which films are recommended for residences?
faqPage.arq1A: We offer solar control, anti-vandalism, security and decorative films. The choice depends on the need: thermal comfort, privacy, shard protection or design.
faqPage.arq2Q: Does the film reduce the energy bill?
faqPage.arq2A: Yes! Solar control films can reduce air conditioning energy consumption by up to 30% by rejecting up to 80% of solar heat.
faqPage.arq3Q: Does the film damage the glass?
faqPage.arq3A: No. INSULFILM™ films are applied with professional techniques and can be removed without damaging the glass.
faqPage.war1Q: How do I know if the film is original?
faqPage.war1A: Every original INSULFILM™ film has an authenticity certificate with a verifiable QR Code. Buy only from authorized dealers.
faqPage.war2Q: How do I claim the warranty?
faqPage.war2A: Contact the authorized center where you had the application done or our Service Center via WhatsApp. You need to present the invoice and authenticity certificate.
faqPage.war3A: The warranty covers manufacturing defects such as discoloration, bubbles, peeling and delamination. It does not cover damage caused by misuse or accidents.
faqPage.gen1Q: Where can I find an INSULFILM™ Authorized Center?
faqPage.gen1A: Visit our "Store Locator" page to find Authorized Centers, accredited installers and dealerships in São Paulo.
faqPage.gen2Q: How do I become a partner/franchisee?
faqPage.gen2A: Visit our "Become a Partner" page or contact our commercial team via WhatsApp to learn about partnership options.
